office_does: Fire commissioners set the fire district's budget and tax levy and oversee its fire and emergency services; this would be the new district's first board.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Kurt M. Blanchard is the only candidate for Position 2 on the first board of the proposed Rimrock Meadows fire district, which exists only if voters approve its formation on the same ballot.

candidates.summary: Small construction company owner running for the new district's first board on cooperation with neighboring districts and fiscal transparency; the only candidate for Position 2.
highlights: Wants close cooperation with neighboring fire districts [S1]
Says fire governance should stay separate from political endorsements [S1]
